findings.sql_generated: SELECT * FROM screens WHERE id IN (?) ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
findings.rows_locked: Exact rows in screens table corresponding to target screen_ids, sorted by id ascending to prevent deadlocks
findings.timing_of_lock: Acquired at the beginning of the transaction BEFORE any availability, capacity, or duration reads
findings.rows_not_locked: Does NOT lock booking_screens or bookings rows
findings.concurrency_protection: Because any concurrent booking for the same asset(s) executes lockScreensForBooking within its transaction, the second transaction blocks at MySQL level until the first commits. After the first commits, the second observes the committed booking_screens records and rejects the overbooking if capacity is full.

findings.concurrency_risk: Two concurrent verification webhook requests for the same order could simultaneously read payment_status='pending' before either commits. A race condition is currently possible unless MySQL unique key or external gateway deduplication prevents it.

verifications.mechanism: DB::transaction() automatic rollback on unhandled Exception/Throwable

findings.result: Injected failures revert all preceding INSERT / UPDATE operations, preserving zero database pollution.
